examples.title: Standard Column Multiplication
examples.explanation: We multiply by the units place and tens place separately and add the results.

examples.title: Dairy Calculation
examples.problem: A crate holds 24 milk bottles. How many bottles in 15 crates?
examples.explanation: Repeated addition of 24 fifteen times is multiplication.

examples.title: Zero in Multiplication
examples.explanation: To multiply numbers ending in zeros, multiply the digits and add the total count of zeros at the end.
